hypothesis: A capability leaves a recurring difference between the connected traces of correct and wrong answers, and editing the weights where that difference recurs can repair the capability. The held-member reading (460c3ebb) found the difference of the registered STATES in answers that were left out of both the reference and the direction, at every merge. A state at a merge is everything added before it, so that reading does not say where along the path the difference is made. This reading tests Astra's statement of it: some of the reproducible late state discrepancy is associated with what a transformation adds, rather than being only an inherited state contrast or a changing nearest comparison point.
why_this_direction: The method's third step is the discrepancy between the overlaps along the whole path, with where it appears reported and not chosen in advance. What has been read so far is the discrepancy of the states after each merge. Three recorded results say that this is not yet the place to edit. (1) Every candidate that aimed a matrix at the state difference at its own merge repaired wrong answers and changed correct ones: B (correction-at-17-original, result.json) completed six originally wrong fitting answers and left three originally correct ones with a required-energy error; C (correction-members-at-17-original, result.json) completed six, two of them B's, and left five originally correct answers no longer complete. (2) Changing only the wrong side's target at layer 17's attention to the nearest mixture of the correct answers took the request off the heading and the line, kept it after the sign, and did not part the four correct answers' deciding rows from the wrong answers' movement (mixture-at-17-original, result.json; Astra's assessment at a86214ed). (3) With a wrong and a correct answer both left out, the state difference is there at every one of the 105 merges (460c3ebb: over places 169 to 201 the left-out wrong answer lies over the left-out correct one in 0.94 to 1.00 of the pairs at every merge; at the row that writes the sign, place 168, in 0.71 after layer 0's attention and 0.94 to 1.00 from layer 12). A difference present after every merge was not made at every merge: a state carries what the merges before it added. The hypothesis asks for the weights where the difference lives, and a matrix can change only what its own merge adds. So the next reading of step 3 is the one that splits each merge's outgoing difference into what came in and what the merge added, at all merges and places, on the recordings already kept. It needs no new data and no solve, and it is what a later request to the solver would have to stand on.
repeating_pattern_check: Four things have happened more than once. (1) A construction asked a matrix for the whole state difference at its merge, and correct answers moved with the wrong ones: a2-path broke 12 of the 30 correct answers; correction-at-19, B and C each changed correct answers; the mixture target at layer 17 did not part them. Why we think it recurs: the difference at a merge is mostly carried in from before it, and a matrix made to cancel what it did not add has to do so with an output the correct answers' rows pass through as well. This run tests that reason directly and solves nothing: how much of a left-out answer's part of the recurring difference a merge adds, against how much comes in. (2) A reading leaned towards the wrong group because the tested answers helped to make the reference or the direction (members_against_the_span.py, corrected by the held-member reading). Every reading here keeps 460c3ebb's design: the reference of a correct answer is the other twenty-nine, and the direction of a pair is built without the tested wrong answer, a wrong answer to its case and a wrong answer to the tested correct answer's case. (3) A change of the comparison was read as the model's doing (the fitting-only mixture reading of members_in_the_gap.py took other means and no radius, and was no measurement of the target later declared). Here the nearest mixture is another one after every merge, so the coefficients found on the incoming features are held fixed through the merge, and what the change of the nearest mixture makes is its own term, never counted as added. (4) The two groups' questions differ (v = 8 in 24 of the 30 wrong answers' questions and in 13 of the 30 correct ones'), and a difference that follows the question's numbers was read beside one that follows the outcome. The 46 pairs with the same m, v and drop are kept apart in every reading, and the identity is given no meaning it does not have: a merge's response to a different input is also something it adds.
what_went_wrong_before: The mixture diagnostic at layer 17 (6e9bacc3) changed the wrong side's target at one matrix and still asked that matrix for a state difference; it did not separate the four correct answers on the wrong answers' line. Astra's assessment (a86214ed, and the specification) scoped what the held-member reading shows: reproducible discrimination within the original cohort, not yet a computation-error target. Before this declaration this session told Astra that the fixed-comparison identity could be run on the recordings. Checked against the code, that holds with three gaps, stated in rule.states and reported per merge by the run: what a matrix's merge adds was not kept and is rebuilt from the matrix's recorded input; the per-layer embedding's part was not kept and is the difference of two states; the last layer's outgoing state is not on record and is each row's recorded direction times its recorded size. Earlier today this session walked kept-row solves in development without a declaration; this reading is declared before its first command. The first attempt at round two was deleted because it never built on the overlap: this reads the registered overlap of all sixty answers and nothing else.

rule.states: The residual stream goes through three merges a layer, each an addition in the engine (pipeline/acquisition/export_stream_traces.py, connections): attention, feedforward and layer (the per-layer embedding's part). A layer's output is its last merge times one positive number, which is no addition: it turns nothing and multiplies every term of the next merge's incoming side alike. Row by row (a row is one answer step), h- is the state a merge adds to, a what it adds, h+ = h- + a. Attention and feedforward: h- is the recorded state (input-overlap's inputs); a is rebuilt from the matrix's recorded input, the matrix and the learned scale as the engine multiplied it (ladder.Merge, tube.multiplied: g y / rms(y)), because the contribution itself was not kept. Layer: h- is the feedforward merge as rebuilt; h+ is the next layer's recorded input over the layer's output scale; a = h+ - h-, because the per-layer embedding's part was not kept as a field. Last layer: no next input is on record, and h+ is each row's recorded direction (the recorded direction after attention plus the two recorded turns that follow it) times its recorded size. Each merge's log line says which of these its three states are.
rule.registration: Each answer's rows are laid on the 480 places of the frozen registration (trace-overlap-complete-registered) and averaged at a place with the registration's own weights, one over the number of the answer's steps there (tube.Layout.means), the same for h-, a and h+ and before anything else: H-, A and H+ = H- + A, per answer and place. No state is made from a mean direction and a mean log size.
rule.steps: The 105 merges in the model's order, and after them one step that is no merge: the model's output norm on the last merge's state (correction.passed_on), through which the frozen reference reads the last merge. It adds nothing to a state: only its features are read, before and after it, and it has no raw terms. The last merge itself is read on its own state, like every other merge.
rule.comparison_point: For a correct answer j the reference is the other twenty-nine correct answers, as in 460c3ebb. A tested answer t (each wrong answer, and j itself) is compared with the mixture of the twenty-nine nearest to it in the joint features: the registered unit state and log size, |direction|^2 + (w_size / w_direction) size^2 with the frozen reference's weights, no radius (mixture.joined). alpha+ are the coefficients found on a step's outgoing features, read as the frozen reference reads them (tube.recorded; the size as the engine recorded it). alpha- are the coefficients of the incoming features and are held fixed through the step. The incoming state of a step is the outgoing state of the step before it (times the layer's output scale between two layers, which changes no direction and moves every log size alike), so alpha- of a step are alpha+ of the step before; for the model's first merge they are found on the features of the embedding's rows, the state layer 0's attention adds to.
rule.identity: In the registered raw states, for a tested answer t and its twenty-nine reference members i: incoming e- = H-[t] - sum_i alpha-_i H-[i]; added D = A[t] - sum_i alpha-_i A[i], what the merge adds to t less what it adds to the comparison held fixed; comparison C = - sum_i (alpha+_i - alpha-_i) H+[i], what the change of the nearest mixture makes, which is no contribution of the merge; outgoing e+ = H+[t] - sum_i alpha+_i H+[i] = e- + D + C. These are vectors: their lengths do not add, and the squares are kept with all their cross products. Beside them, and named apart, the same split of the features (direction, size, joint): incoming, through (the features' change through the step at the comparison held fixed), comparison, outgoing. A feature split is no raw contribution and is not called one.
rule.readings: For every pair of a wrong answer i and a correct answer j, with the builders of 460c3ebb (the wrong answers other than i, other than a wrong answer to i's case and other than a wrong answer to j's case). (a) On the outgoing direction: common = the sum of the builders' e+, one direction a pair, held fixed; a_term = <term[i], common> / |common| and b_term = <term[j], common> / |common| for each of the four terms, so that a_outgoing = a_incoming + a_added + a_comparison exactly, and likewise b. (b) Each term's own: common = the sum of the builders' same term; for the added term this asks whether what a merge adds recurs by itself in a left-out wrong answer and not in a left-out correct one. (c) The features: the four-way feature split read on the builders' outgoing leftover, in the direction, in the size and jointly. Kept per step and place for each: the share of the 900 pairs with a over b (0.5 if the groups did not differ), the shares resolved either way, the means of a and b, of a over its term's length and b over its, of the lengths, and the three shares over the 46 pairs with the same m, v and drop; the ten products of two raw terms for a wrong and for a correct answer; per answer, each raw term's mean projection, its length, and how much of it is resolved; for the four pairs that are one case, the terms themselves.
rule.uncertainty: A search ends with a bound on what it leaves of its cost over the least cost, and the mixture found lies within e = sqrt(bound / w_direction) of the true nearest one in the joint features. A raw term is a product of the coefficients with other vectors than those features, so its error is bounded through the coefficients: for a difference d of two sets of coefficients, |M'd| <= kappa |Z'd|, with kappa(M | Z) the largest of |M'd| / |Z'd| over the differences that sum to nothing, from the members' two Gram matrices. incoming: e- kappa(H- | Z-); added: e- kappa(A | Z-); comparison: e+ kappa(H+ | Z+) + e- kappa(H+ | Z-); outgoing: e+ kappa(H+ | Z+); the feature terms likewise. Where the members' features do not determine the coefficients kappa is infinite and the term is reported as undetermined. A pair is resolved where a and b lie farther apart than the two vectors' bounds and the turn of the common direction allow; otherwise it is unresolved, which is neither agreement nor the lack of a difference. kappa is taken over every difference of coefficients, also those a mixture could not make: it can overstate an uncertainty, never understate it.
rule.deals: The same reading with the sixty answers dealt into two thirties at random, at the steps parameters.deals names: what these statistics give on these recordings when the split means nothing, with its spread over the deals. An observed level, not a threshold (Astra's assessment of 460c3ebb).
rule.checks: Each step's log line keeps: the rebuilt merge's size against the size the engine recorded; at an attention merge the rebuilt outgoing state against the recorded one; at the last layer the same rebuild made one layer earlier against the state on record there; the outgoing square against the squares and cross products of its three parts; the incoming term against the term the step before put out, times the layer's output scale between them; the leftovers as laid against the searches' own costs; every search's loops, loops allowed, bound and cost. The read command lays this run's outgoing feature reading beside 460c3ebb's array. A check that fails is reported with the result, and the terms it touches are named.
rule.data_roles: All sixty registered original answers are read, the thirty no-fit ones among them, as the frozen reference and 460c3ebb read them: their original recordings only. Nothing is fitted, selected, tuned, generated or evaluated, so no answer has a fitting or a held role here, and no number of this run selects a model, a ridge, a dose or a threshold. reserved-40b is not read and stays sealed.
rule.scope: A descriptive decomposition on recorded contexts. A merge's response to a different input is also what it adds, so no label of input against error and no correction mask follows from the identity alone. The comparison is the nearest mixture of the other correct answers in the frozen joint features; another comparison would give other terms. The last layer's outgoing raw state and every layer merge's contribution are derived, not recorded. Sixty answers of one template: nothing here is a claim about other questions.
rule.card: Card 1 under /run/user/1000/gpu1.lock for map and deals; read uses no card. No engine call is made, so nothing here is an engine output compared across cards: the method's one card is for what the engine computes, and the recordings read were all made on GPU0 (wide-overlap). 460c3ebb's reading ran on card 1 the same way.
rule.storage: The per-step arrays (map/, about 0.3 GB) and the deals' (deals/, under 0.1 GB) are bulk data: archived with torad-research (store root <repo>/studies), verified there, ignored by git and kept locally. Committed: the map's index and log, the deals' indexes and logs, the tables by step and stretch (text and JSON), the figure, the commands' logs, provenance.json and result.json; the per-place arrays are the ones in map/. Inputs and other runs are only read. Nothing is removed.

joint_weights.derivation: The frozen reference's scales S_direction 1268.5365669493656 and S_size 28.67797931944294: a cell weighs w_f = 0.5 / S_f (3.9415e-04 for the direction, 1.7435e-02 for the size), so the joint reading in the direction's units is |direction|^2 + 44.23381971299945 size^2, the same at every merge and place. The command stops if the reference's index is not the one with the declared hash.
joint_weights.scales_with: The original model, its reference of all sixty answers and the terminal transform. Another source needs its own reference.

reference_members.derivation: The registered cohort's thirty correct answers. For a correct answer j the reference is the other twenty-nine; no answer is weighed beforehand, and the coefficients are what the joint cost's least value gives at each place.

builders_left_out.derivation: A case is an answer's id without its ending -h1 or -h3 (and -channel): two answers of one case have prompts that differ in one token. For a pair (i, j) the builders leave out i, a wrong answer to i's case and a wrong answer to j's case. In this cohort six pairs of wrong answers are one case, no two correct answers are, and four cases have a wrong and a correct answer (discovery-10-channel, discovery-11-channel, discovery-17-channel, expanded-022).

matched_pairs.derivation: The (wrong, correct) pairs whose questions have the same m, v and drop (each case's case.json, parameters): 46 of the 900. They differ in the loss and the rise at most. The count is checked by the command against the cases it reads.

search_end.derivation: A search ends when the summed bound of its problems is at most sqrt(2.220446049250313e-16) = 1.4901161193847656e-08 of their summed cost: the search's arithmetic is float64 and a cost is a square, so a distance is resolved to the square root of the arithmetic's rounding. The last loop allowed is the square of the number of members (841 for twenty-nine; 900 for the thirty of the search that only gives the others their start). In 460c3ebb the greatest summed bound over summed cost was 1.5e-08 and no search took more than 41 loops. The same end as that reading, so that the outgoing coefficients here are that reading's.
search_end.scales_with: The arithmetic and the number of members.

searched_together.derivation: Five correct answers' references are searched in one call: what card 1 held for 460c3ebb's full reading (2,464 s for 105 merges). Problems searched together share one end, so this number can move a coefficient inside its recorded bound and no further; it is kept at 460c3ebb's five so that the calls are the same.
searched_together.scales_with: The card's free memory, the number of places and of answers.

deals.derivation: The twelve seeds (1 to 12) and the three merges 460c3ebb's deals read: layer 0's attention (step 0), layer 17's attention (step 51) and the model's last merge (step 104), with the output step (105) because that reading took the last merge through the output norm. A deal permutes which thirty answers are read as correct (numpy default_rng(seed).permutation). Deals are not read at the other steps: a comparison with them is made only at these.
deals.scales_with: The card time afforded: more deals narrow the spread's estimate, more steps widen where a comparison can be made.

stretches.derivation: Reporting windows only, those of the held-member reading's tables: places 0 to 2, 3 to 19, 20 to 75, 76 to 148, 149 to 159 (the heading), 160 to 167 (the line as far as the row before the sign's), 168 (the row that writes the sign), 169 to 171, 172 to 201 and 202 to 479. Every array is kept per place, so any other window can be read from this run.
stretches.scales_with: The registration's axis and where the held-member reading changed along it.

prediction: Written before any incoming, added or comparison term exists. (1) What a merge adds recurs. Over places 168 to 201, where 460c3ebb read the state difference in left-out answers, at each of the three merges the deals read (layer 0's attention, layer 17's attention, the last merge): read along the other wrong answers' own added parts, a left-out wrong answer's added part lies over a left-out correct answer's in a larger share of the pairs than any of the twelve deals gives at that merge and stretch, and in more than half of the pairs with the same m, v and drop. (2) Most of the difference is carried, not made at the merge. Along the outgoing direction, the incoming term's mean projection for the left-out wrong answers is the largest of the three terms at most of the 105 merges, over places 168 to 201: a merge adds a small part to a state that carries every earlier one. (3) Where it grows at the row that writes the sign. At place 168 the left-out wrong answers' part of the common direction rises between layer 0 and layer 12 (460c3ebb). Among the merges of layers 0 to 12 at which their mean outgoing projection is larger than their mean incoming one, the added term's mean projection is positive and larger than the comparison term's at more merges than not, and larger than the left-out correct answers' mean added projection at more merges than not. No prediction is made of how much the bounds leave unresolved in the added and comparison terms: kappa has not been computed on these recordings, and where it leaves most pairs unresolved or the term undetermined, that is the result for those cells.
would_weaken_it: The added-component interpretation is weakened where: the added part's own reading is no higher than the deals give (what merges add does not recur across wrong answers); or a left-out correct answer has as much of it (a share near one half, or as many pairs resolved one way as the other: not told from the correct answers' own variation); or it holds over all pairs and not over the 46 with the same m, v and drop (it follows the question's numbers); or the growth of the outgoing difference at the sign's row is carried by the comparison term (a moving comparison point, not a contribution); or the bounds leave the added term unresolved or undetermined (the saved fields do not settle it). If prediction (2) fails, and the added term is the larger part at many merges, the difference is made again at each merge and not carried: that weakens this declaration's reason for the first repeating pattern, not the hypothesis. Each of these limits what this decomposition says about where the difference is added, on these sixty recordings with this comparison. None is evidence that the capability difference is absent or cannot be repaired: repairs and transfer are observed.
